sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a beaver character standing upright on its hind legs, holding a stick in both paws. Draw this exact beaver as a cut-out paper puppet for animation: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, fur texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the plump brown standing body with its cream tummy, turned slightly left as in image 1, without head, arms, legs, feet or tail; its top (the neck, normally under the head) rounded; its sides smooth where the arms were; its bottom a full round furry seat that would cover the tops of the legs.
2. the head: the big round brown head with its two small round ears, dark nose and rosy cheeks, turned slightly left as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth, no teeth — keep the nose, the cheeks and the cream muzzle; its bottom edge rounded.
3. the near arm: the arm reaching across the tummy in image 1 (from the shoulder on the right of image 1), drawn whole from a full, rounded, furry shoulder to its dark paw curled closed as if gripping a stick.
4. the far arm: the short arm on the left of image 1, drawn whole from a full, rounded, furry shoulder to its dark paw curled closed as if gripping a stick.
5. one arm raised with its dark paw open, palm to the viewer, little fingers spread as if waving hello, with a full rounded shoulder.
6. the stick: the same gnawed stick as in image 1 — rough brown bark, a pointed, freshly gnawed pale top, a cut bottom end and its little sprig of three green leaves — drawn whole, including the part hidden behind the paws, but much thicker and chunkier than in image 1: about twice as thick, a short stout stick, the same length.
7. one hind leg: the short stout hind leg on the right of image 1, with its whole furry thigh up to a full rounded hip at the top, and its big dark webbed foot flat on the ground.
8. the tail: the flat dark brown paddle tail with its criss-cross scale pattern, lying flat as in image 1, with a rounded base.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a beaver character standing upright and holding a stick; image 2 shows the same beaver cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the beaver's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the beaver in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the beaver's left eye (the bigger one, on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle and a little white around it.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the eyebrow as in image 1: a short thin dark-brown arc.
7. the mouth as it is in image 1: a happy smile with the two big white front teeth showing below it.
8. the mouth gnawing: lips drawn back, the two big front teeth bared and biting, a little open.
9. the mouth chomping: the same, the mouth a little wider open, the two big front teeth showing, cheeks pushed up.
10. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink, the two big front teeth at the top.
11. the mouth wide open in a big sleepy yawn: a tall oval, the inside pink, the two big front teeth at the top.
12. the mouth open in a small round 'o', the two front teeth just showing at the top.
13. the mouth in a small sad frown, the two front teeth just showing.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the beaver lifts its stick and gnaws along it with its big front teeth so little wood chips fly, then holds up the pointy stick to admire it and pats it proudly.

pause.shows: the beaver holding up its freshly gnawed pointy stick, admiring it

animations.description: the beaver waddles along to the left on its hind legs holding its stick, flat tail dragging, then stops.
the beaver lifts its big flat tail and slaps it on the ground, slap, slap!
the beaver waves hello with its free paw, holding its stick in the other.
the beaver lifts its nose and sniffs the air, its whiskers twitching.
{the} gives a big yawn, closes its eyes and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.
